request.what: Withdraw treasury funds for Intersect Technical Steering Committee Support over 12 months.

claims.claim: Intersect requests 1,193,000 ADA, stated as $298,250, to support Technical Steering Committee activities for 12 months.
The proposal allocates 256,000 ADA to WP 1, 832,000 ADA to WP 2, and 105,000 ADA to WP 3, totaling 1,193,000 ADA.
The work packages cover community-facing technical coordination, protocol governance and evolution, and a pilot independent technical review programme launching in 2027.
Execution of the work packages is contingent on approval of the IntersectMBO budget proposal.
The proposal says all expenditure will be fully accounted for and any unspent funds returned to the Cardano treasury.
The proposal says it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and provides related voting and audit references.
The proposer states the requested amount does not breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission.
Independent audits and assurance for this proposal will be provided by Appold, with possible reviews of deliverables, controls, spending, and milestone evidence.

Intersect discloses that the Technical Steering Committee has not received Cardano Treasury funding within the past 24 months, while Intersect and its committees received 22,385,000 ADA through listed prior governance actions.

Funds will be administered through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses, external oversight entities, multi-party authorization thresholds, and a public dashboard for auditability.

summary: The document requests 1,193,000 ADA for 12 months of TSC support across technical coordination, protocol governance, and technical review, with stated budget breakdowns, smart-contract custody, oversight arrangements, prior-funding disclosures, and several external references for verification.
